title: A cancelled flight
es: Negociar con una aerolínea tras una cancelación y conocer tus derechos
goal: Exponer hechos con precisión, citar derechos, rechazar una oferta insuficiente y cerrar un acuerdo.
phrases: I was informed at the last minute that...
Me informaron a última hora de que...
Under the regulations, I'm entitled to...
Según la normativa tengo derecho a...

turns.t: Thank you for waiting, sir. I understand you're here regarding flight two-one-four to Madrid, which was cancelled this morning. I'm very sorry for the disruption. How can I assist you?
turns.es: Gracias por esperar. Entiendo que viene por el vuelo dos-uno-cuatro a Madrid, cancelado esta mañana. Lamento la interrupción. ¿En qué puedo ayudarle?

y.say: I was informed at the last minute that my flight was cancelled, and I have an important meeting tomorrow morning, so I need to be rebooked on the earliest possible flight.
y.es: Me informaron a última hora de que mi vuelo se canceló y tengo una reunión importante mañana temprano, así que necesito que me reubiquen en el primer vuelo posible.
alts: They told me at the last moment that my flight was cancelled and I have an important meeting in the morning, so I need the first possible flight.
y.hint: I was informed at the last minute...

turns.t: I completely understand. Unfortunately, the next direct flight with available seats is at noon tomorrow. There's an alternative through Lisbon this evening, but it involves a three-hour layover, and you'd arrive at midnight.
turns.es: Lo entiendo. Lamentablemente, el próximo vuelo directo con plazas sale mañana a mediodía. Hay una alternativa por Lisboa esta tarde, con tres horas de escala, llegando a medianoche.

c.q: What are the two options offered?
o: A noon flight tomorrow or a flight through Lisbon tonight
A refund or a hotel only

y.say: The Lisbon route works better for me, since I can't afford to miss the meeting. However, I'd like to know what compensation I'm entitled to under the regulations.
y.es: La ruta por Lisboa me conviene más, porque no puedo faltar a la reunión. Sin embargo, quisiera saber qué compensación me corresponde según la normativa.
alts: I prefer the route through Lisbon because I cannot miss the meeting. But I want to know what compensation I have the right to under the rules.
y.hint: I'd like to know what compensation...

turns.t: Of course. Since the cancellation was due to a technical fault, and you were notified less than fourteen days before departure, you're entitled to compensation. In this case, that would be two hundred and fifty euros, plus meals and refreshments during the wait.
turns.es: Por supuesto. Como la cancelación fue por un fallo técnico y le avisaron con menos de catorce días, tiene derecho a compensación: doscientos cincuenta euros, más comidas y refrigerios durante la espera.

y.say: That's helpful, but it doesn't quite cover the cost of the taxi I had booked and the hotel I have already paid for in Madrid tonight. Could those expenses be reimbursed as well?
y.es: Es útil, pero no cubre del todo el taxi que había reservado ni el hotel que ya pagué en Madrid esta noche. ¿Podrían reembolsarse esos gastos?
alts: It helps, but it does not fully cover the taxi and the hotel I paid for tonight in Madrid. Can you refund those expenses too?

turns.t: If you can provide receipts, we can process a claim for reasonable expenses. I can't promise the full amount, but hotel cancellations are normally reimbursed. I'll need photos of the receipts sent to our customer service email.
turns.es: Si presenta recibos, podemos tramitar un reclamo por gastos razonables. No puedo prometer el monto completo, pero las cancelaciones de hotel suelen reembolsarse. Necesito fotos de los recibos enviadas a nuestro correo de atención.

y.say: I'll send the receipts today. In the meantime, I'd like that in writing, both the compensation and the promise to review my expenses, so there's no misunderstanding later.
y.es: Enviaré los recibos hoy. Mientras tanto, quisiera eso por escrito, tanto la compensación como el compromiso de revisar mis gastos, para que no haya malentendidos.
alts: I will send the receipts today. Meanwhile please put it in writing, the compensation and the promise to review my expenses, to avoid misunderstandings.

turns.t: Absolutely. I'll email you a written confirmation within the hour, and I've also upgraded your seat on the Lisbon flight, free of charge, as a gesture of goodwill. Your boarding pass will be ready at gate twelve.
turns.es: Por supuesto. Le enviaré confirmación por escrito en menos de una hora, y he mejorado su asiento en el vuelo a Lisboa sin costo como gesto de buena voluntad. Su tarjeta de embarque estará en la puerta doce.

y.say: In light of the circumstances, I appreciate the gesture. Thank you for your help, and I'll be waiting for that email.
y.es: Dadas las circunstancias, aprecio el gesto. Gracias por su ayuda y esperaré ese correo.
alts: Considering the situation I appreciate it. Thanks for helping me, I am waiting for the email.
